titulo: Project: the people plan + What changed
lead: The owner wants to know if the team can handle the change; the team wants to know what happens to them. Both answers fit on one page: who does what, how the conversation was held, how new people are trained, which values apply to people and agents, how performance is evaluated, and how agents come in and go out. The project is this plan, approved by rubric.
objetivo: deliver the area's people plan on one page and get it approved by the rubric, read by the people it affects and signed by the person who is accountable.

aprende.t: The five blocks of the people plan on one page
Applying the rubric, including the items that fail the plan on their own
Who reads it first, who signs, and when to review
What changed through October 2026, with date, source, and type

hero_alt: The manager presents a single sheet with colored blocks to the owner and two colleagues at a round table; behind the glass, the warehouse with pallets.

secoes.sub: Five blocks on one page, each backed by the pieces from one or two lessons, plus the rubric and the read-through by the people affected. Tap each part.
secoes.volta: Failed on one item: go back to the block that failed, not to zero

nos.detalhe: The work-split matrix: what stays with each person, what goes to the agent, what both do together with whoever decides, and where the freed-up time goes.
The example's team agreement (data rule, room to experiment) and the honest conversation: when it was held, what was said, the open questions with dates, and the commitments.
The 30-day path for new hires and the training for people who supervise agents, with a mentor and backups.
The team's values with the agent's version, and the evaluation sheets for roles that work with agents, with no volume target for the agent.
The area's agent register with owner and status, and the onboarding and offboarding procedure.

The rubric gives the score and has five items that fail the plan on their own. At Horizonte, Patrícia builds it, Juliana and Sandra read it and say whether what is written actually happened, and Carlos signs.

secoes.legenda: Teaching approval of the plan does not replace HR policies, labor agreements, or the decisions of whoever is accountable for the company.

secoes.sub: Four steps. The Horizonte plan is practice; your area's plan is the one that counts.

texto: The page summarizes; the pieces prove it. Each block has two or three lines and points to the lesson document that backs it: matrix, script, path, values, sheets, register.
Mark what has already happened and what is only intent. "Meeting held on 10/30" and "meeting planned" carry different weight at signing.

exemplo.texto: "People plan · sales · v1 · Nov 2026": one page up front; behind it, the pieces from lessons 1 to 7.

texto: The rubric adds up to 100 points across six blocks. You pass with 75 or more and all five must-haves checked. One missing must-have fails the plan, even at 95 points.

The must-haves protect people: a decision with a name on it, no promise the company hasn't made, learning by hand before reviewing, no one punished for pointing out an agent's mistake, no agent without an owner.

exemplo.texto: Run the panel prompt (next to this). It points out gaps; the score is up to you, and to whoever signs.

passos.sub: and whoever answers for it signs
texto: In the people plan, the ones who read before signing are the people affected: they say whether the conversation, the path and the sheet happened as written. It's not a vote; it's a check.
Whoever signs is the person who answers for the people and the budget. They read the page, check the must-haves, and ask, ideally, about what is still unknown.

exemplo.texto: Patrícia puts it together. Juliana checks her own conversation and her sheet; Sandra checks Lucas's path. Carlos reads it, asks what happens to customer service in a year, and signs knowing the honest answer is "we don't know yet."

texto: The plan goes out with a review date: every quarter, or sooner if a new agent comes in, someone new joins, or the conversation with the team needs to be redone.
At the review, what was an intention becomes a fact or goes back into the plan: was the path completed? was the new sheet used? were the open questions answered?

exemplo.texto: An agent came in or left, or the work-split matrix changed: redo the conversation with those affected before touching the evaluation.

BLOCK                          POINTS  CRITERION FOR FULL POINTS

                                       who decides and deadline; agreed use of freed-up time

secoes.sub: Quarterly panel, replaced at each course review. Each item comes with a date, a source and the type of claim: vendor survey, self-reported experience, forecast or study. The method in lessons 1 to 7 doesn't depend on any of them.

texto: Microsoft, Work Trend Index 2025: the human manager of agents ("agent boss") and the metric balancing human oversight against agent efficiency ("human-agent ratio"). Work Trend Index 2026 (05/2026): 20,000 people in 10 countries; 16% are "Frontier Professionals," who use agents in multi-step workflows and redesign their work; when the manager uses AI in front of the team, perceived value goes up 17 points.
Type: research done by the company that sells the tool. An analysis in The Microsoft Cloud Blog (05/2026) reminds readers that these numbers shouldn't carry a business case on their own.

exemplo.texto: Use it as a signal for block 2 (example and conversation). The proof is what happens on your team after the agreement.

texto: McKinsey ("agentic organization"): small teams built around outcomes, with 2 to 5 people supervising 50 to 100 agents. This is the consultancy's self-reported experience, not a measured study. Gartner (Oct 2024 forecast): by the end of 2026, 1 in 5 organizations will use AI to flatten their structure and cut more than half of middle management positions.
Critics point out that taking the layer off the org chart doesn't eliminate its work: coordinating, reviewing, training juniors.

exemplo.texto: Block 1 (roles) and block 3 (training) are the practical answer: who does the work the layer used to do.

texto: Stanford Digital Economy Lab (08/2026): a relative drop of about 19% in employment among young people aged 22 to 25 in the occupations most exposed to AI, without claiming that AI is the cause. Indeed: the share of entry-level postings fell from 29% to 10%.
The data shows a narrower door; it doesn't say what each company should do. The path in lesson 4 is one of the answers.

exemplo.texto: Cite the data as it is: what it shows and what it does not prove. It is the same care as in lesson 3.

texto: Deloitte (Tech Trends 2026): onboarding of agents into data and operations, graduated autonomy, and training for human supervisors. Forrester (Predictions 2026, forecast): the large HR platforms will include "digital employee" management.
Okta (AI Agents at Work 2026, vendor survey): nearly two-thirds of organizations apply weaker security controls to agents than to employees.

exemplo.texto: January 2027, with the following quarter's overview. What is method (lessons 1 to 7) does not change; what is numbers and forecasts does.

secoes.sub: The four deliverables that support the people plan and the exercises that produce them. Click an exercise to see its "done when".

degraus.saida: Weekly team agreement kept and data rule set.
degraus.passo: It starts with you: the team needs to see the leader using it before hearing any plan. The week of real use takes seven days.

degraus.saida: Work-split matrix read by one person on the team.
degraus.passo: The matrix is the basis for the conversation, the training and the evaluation. Do it with the person, not about them.

degraus.saida: Meeting held, questions noted and commitments on the calendar.
degraus.passo: Requires the matrix. The simulation with Juliana is the rehearsal before the real meeting.

degraus.saida: Path, values, new evaluation sheet and agent register.
degraus.passo: With the conversation done, the rest sustains the change: the path for newcomers (lesson 4), the values (lesson 5), the sheet (lesson 6) and the register (lesson 7).

rolagem_fim.texto: Open, split, talk and sustain, in this order. Each deliverable uses the previous one, and the plan only goes to signature when the "done when" of each step is true.

secoes.sub: 4 questions. The explanation appears after your attempt.

perguntas.p: The plan scored 91 points, but it says "no one on the team will lose their job" with no written company decision. Result?
opcoes: Approved: 91 is well above the minimum of 75
Approved with a caveat, to fix in the review
Failed: an undecided promise is mandatory
perguntas.explica: The required items exist so that a high score does not hide a big problem. The plan goes back to the conversation block, not to zero.

perguntas.p: Why do Juliana and Sandra read the plan before it is signed?
opcoes: To check that what was written actually happened
To vote on whether the plan takes effect or not
perguntas.explica: People who are affected know whether what is on paper actually happened. It is a check, not a vote; the person who answers for the area still signs.

perguntas.p: McKinsey talks about 2 to 5 people supervising 50 to 100 agents. What kind of claim is this?
perguntas.explica: The type of claim changes its weight: self-reported experience, forecast, vendor survey and study all weigh differently. In the plan, none of them replaces what happens on your team.

perguntas.p: A new agent joined the area three weeks after the signing. What should you do?
opcoes: Onboard, review the work-split matrix and talk with the people affected
Wait for the quarterly review set in the plan
Redo the whole plan from scratch, with the team
perguntas.explica: The plan ages by event, not only by date. A new agent changes roles; those affected are heard before the evaluation changes.
